title: One-day scent trail
intro: Indian flowers, Malay-Muslim attar, colonial spices and Chinese incense, in one walkable day. Avoid Sundays, when many Arab Street shops close.

stops.name: Kopitiam breakfast: kaya toast
stops.blurb: Start with kopi and kaya toast: the Nanyang breakfast, and pandan in the kaya.

stops.name: Little India garland stalls
stops.blurb: Jasmine, rose and tuberose garlands at Jothi Store & Flower Shop, 1 Campbell Lane.

stops.name: Jamal Kazura Aromatics
stops.blurb: Attar since 1933, with a heritage mini-gallery in the shop.

stops.name: Lunch near Sultan Mosque
stops.blurb: Around Bussorah St and Kandahar St.

stops.name: Sifr Aromatics workshop
stops.blurb: Blend your own perfume at 42 Arab St. Book ahead.

stops.name: Fort Canning Spice Garden
stops.blurb: Nutmeg, clove, pepper and torch ginger on the site of Raffles' 1822 garden. Free.

stops.name: Wak Hai Cheng Bio
stops.blurb: A Teochew temple with hanging spiral incense coils.

stops.name: Hawker dinner in Chinatown
stops.blurb: End at a hawker centre, with a squeeze of calamansi on your plate.
